column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=A well-zoomed map, since you can see even the smallest streets and dead ends.
#Text=It shows an American or English city.
#Text=You can see a college or campus, a university area in green, and a few areas with bars and restaurants to the south.
#Text=The areas are easy to distinguish, and you can easily imagine the house at the end of the small dead end.

#Text=Anchors summary  College / campus (non-named)   University area shown in green (non-named)   Clusters of bars and restaurants in the south (non-named)   Many small streets and alleys (non-named)   Small dead-end / impasse (non-named)   House at the end of the small dead-end (non-named)   Clearly labeled streets (feature, non-named)
